verdict.rationale: Zero publishes an official MCP server in its first-party MCP.md, confirmed by the probe. It exposes a broad email toolset to connected agents: reading threads, listing folders, composing and sending, drafts, deleting, labels, read/unread, bulk archive/delete, search, and AI Q&A over the mailbox. Connecting is clunky, though: the only working method is copying a browser session cookie into the Authorization header, and OAuth is marked 'coming soon'. missing for 10: production-grade auth (OAuth) for agent connection, step-by-step client setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully.
